title: Remove omega-angular integration
description: Reverts eslint-then targets in angular.json, trims ESLint flat config, removes omegaSetupProviders from app.config. Optionally deletes app/omega-setup.ts. Run `npm uninstall omega-angular` afterward.

project.description: Application project name (default: first application in angular.json).

skipAppConfig.description: Do not strip omegaSetupProviders from app.config.ts.

removeEslintDevDependencies.description: Remove eslint, @eslint/js, typescript-eslint from package.json devDependencies (only if present).

deleteOmegaSetup.description: Delete `{sourceRoot}/app/omega-setup.ts` after stripping providers from app.config (use when you no longer need Omega runtime wiring).
